purpose: Preserve artist identity, authorship, license, requested credit, source lineage, modification history, and ethical use preferences for every third-party creative asset used by LuHm OS.

creatorRespectAndCorrection.assetPageAsEvidence: Copy exact author credit, license version, permissions and source revision from the specific asset listing. Do not infer universal license from Sketchfab, Nexus Mods, the word free, or search metadata.

scopeSeparation.studiedSource: reference-only with explicit no affiliation and no game inclusion claim
scopeSeparation.redistributableSource: per-file rights evidence plus human publication review

creatorRespectAndCorrection.credits: TASL-style title, author, source, license and modification notice when relevant; artist spelling and source requested attribution respected.
avoidFalseAssociations: do not imply authors endorsed or collaborated with LuHm OS
never invent an asset creator or CC license
do not expose private contact details
do not publicize unreviewed human reports
creatorConcernFlow: receive private correction or rights concern
bind the exact source URL and asset ID
place affected asset on correction hold promptly
stop future publication of the affected asset and its credit claim while reviewed
check exact listing, recorded license, changes and claimed authorship
correct source attribution or remove/swap disputed asset with human review
clear hold only with documented review and reproof
creatorRespectAndCorrection.removalPreference: If artist asks not to be named, review license-required attribution first. Where legally permitted, remove optional name/link. If attribution is required for continuing reuse and cannot be honored, stop using/distributing the affected asset rather than silently stripping attribution.
creatorRespectAndCorrection.noGuarantee: Source checks do not guarantee absence of all copyright disputes; humans respond and fix errors.
